purpose: Define AccessCore runtime active state separately from configured enablement and current caller authentication, including protection against accidental or unauthorized deactivation.

topics.name: AccessCore Runtime Active State
topics.purpose: Define AccessCore runtime active state separately from configured enablement and current caller authentication, including protection against accidental or unauthorized deactivation.

semantics.active_rule: When active, AccessCore enforcement remains in the runtime request/operation path.
semantics.auth_rule: Active AccessCore may exist with no currently authenticated caller; this results in denied/login-required governed access rather than disabled enforcement.
semantics.disable_rule: Active AccessCore cannot be disabled by ordinary ungoverned runtime mutation.
semantics.change_rule: Disabling/removing AC requires an explicit authorized configuration/change workflow and subsequent lifecycle transition.
semantics.failure_rule: Policy/auth subsystem failure fails protected/closed rather than silently falling back to AC-off behavior.
semantics.visibility_rule: Runtime state is observable separately from instance config flag.
semantics.authority_rule: AC runtime state never substitutes for the caller's rights.

invariants.rule: AccessCore activation, login, assurance and runtime protection are explicit lifecycle semantics; once active, AccessCore cannot be silently bypassed or disabled by an ungoverned runtime/config mutation.

hard_gates.condition: authentication failure treated as AC disabled
ordinary runtime command disables active AC
configured flag and runtime active state conflated

references.purpose: Runtime state remains distinct from config state.

prose.summary: Define AccessCore runtime active state separately from configured enablement and current caller authentication, including protection against accidental or unauthorized deactivation.
